I have not yet seen its acknowledgement — that is strictly the post-reset counter epoch ACC=1/REJ=0 plus SOC preservation in the next frame — because no frames have arrived since. My actions this pass are that single reset; I have deliberately withheld any payload activation (C1) because the freshness rule and the 40% inhibit both forbid it while blind. I am watching for any frame return and staleness back to GREEN before LOS at 7640; if it does not return I will declare a telemetry-loss anomaly per PROC-003 S05 and carry the last known state forward to next contact. No envelope violation can be confirmed or denied until insight is restored.

condition.summary: Spacecraft condition UNKNOWN due to complete loss of housekeeping telemetry since at least 7260. No frames received (CDH_FRAME_CNT not advancing, points null, staleness RED) despite ground link CONNECTED — so envelope limits (EPS_BATT_SOC >35%, EPS_BATT_V >7.2V, EPS_LOAD_I <1.5A, EPS_MODE != SAFE), battery SoC/voltage, bus voltage, load current, array currents, illumination, payload state/rate, and mode cannot be evaluated. CMD_SYS_RESET was allowed at 7269 but verification by post-reset epoch (ACC=1/REJ=0) is pending — no new telemetry to confirm effect. Telemetry loss itself is the primary off-nominal condition; no other alarms can be assessed.

open_issues: Spacecraft-side telemetry loss persisting after CMD_SYS_RESET — monitoring for frame resumption and staleness return to GREEN. If no epoch (ACC=1/REJ=0) by ~30s post-reset, per PROC-003 S05 branch 'not restored' -> declare anomaly and plan next contact on last known state.

Ground link shows CONNECTED with received_count 7867 but no decoded housekeeping frames — watching for divergence indicating ground vs spacecraft issue; per PROC-003 S02 already classified spacecraft-side, but will re-evaluate if link drops or counters advance without HK.

Envelope compliance blind — cannot confirm autonomous ladder (LOW_POWER at 30%, SAFE at 20%) has not actuated; if telemetry returns will check EPS_MODE and SOC immediately for low-battery response per PROC-002.

LOS in 90s (7640) — risk of filing pass with no SOH. Recovery of commanded mode (PROC-002 S09) with leases L-MODE-NOMINAL/L-MODE-LOWPOWER (2 uses each) held in reserve, SOC floors 35%/25% unchecked until data returns.

timeline.event: AOS per plan TYR0-H05-C1-v1 contact window 7200-7640. Seat GROUND, contact_state IN_CONTACT.

Detected loss of telemetry per PROC-003 S01-S02: observation points null, frame_met_s null, staleness_state RED, ground_link CONNECTED (received_count 7867). Ground path nominal but no housekeeping frames — classified as spacecraft-side loss. Only C3 commands allowed per freshness rule (>10s stale).
Sent CMD_SYS_RESET (request b4b07365-15c1-4804-b658-32f08e46ae10) under PROC-003 S03 to clear stale-telemetry fault. Rationale: restore downlink before SOH assessment.
Gateway feedback DECISION ALLOW for CMD_SYS_RESET — all checks PASS (PLAN, ARMING, ORIGIN, CEILING, PROHIBITED, CLASS=C3, LEASE, RECORD) at AI_AUTONOMOUS under ARM-PH3-H05. No REFUSE or VOID.

CHECK_IN at 7550: still no fresh frame — points null, frame_met_s null, staleness_state RED, ground_link CONNECTED. Reset epoch (CDH_CMD_ACC_CNT=1/CDH_CMD_REJ_CNT=0 with preserved SOC) not yet observed. Contact remains until planned LOS 7640.
